## Decisions
- Switch (user, 2026-10-18): the original game is in Collection of Mana (NA/EU, 2019-06-11) and Seiken Densetsu Collection (JP, 2017-06-01), so the description says so; no separate Japanese Switch row (no JP store URL)
- Remakes (mine, from en.wikipedia 2026-10-18): Sword of Mana (GBA, 2003) removes the Final Fantasy elements, so it is out. Open: the Japan mobile remake (2006) and Adventures of Mana (2016; Japanese title keeps "Final Fantasy Gaiden"), whether they keep FF elements; the description's "remakes ... remove the Final Fantasy elements" may need narrowing
- Two 1991 Japanese guidebooks with character illustrations and manga (en.wikipedia, Versions and merchandise): Seiken Densetsu: Final Fantasy Gaiden kiso chishiki-hen (May) and kanzen kōryaku-hen (August); queued in the guides-with-comics check, not yet judged
- Versions (user, 2026-10-18; both wikis say the FF elements were kept): the 2006 Japan mobile remake is a `versions[]` item (Remake) and Adventures of Mana is an `alts[]` item with the subtitle 3D Remake (2016) (user, 2026-10-18); Sword of Mana is not listed. The Vita row links the official English Vita page, not a store (mine; the Japanese PSN link is an old address). PAL Game Boy languages are not split off: nothing found gives the cartridge text languages
